## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Estonia recorded 647K actual service units in 2025, +16.6% compared to 2024 (555K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +5.7% above the plan (612K).

- Actual 2025 service units are -28.2% below the actual 2019 level (901K).
